## Overview

The founding of the Last Stand marks the turning point of mortal civilization. Approximately 200 years ago, the surviving mortal races  -  pushed to the brink of extinction by The Abominable End  -  made their final stand near the center-southeast of the continent and established three capital cities: Skywatch, Emberforge, and Weaveheart.

## Date

Approximately **200 years ago**.

## Causes

After two centuries of relentless monster invasion, the mortal races had been pushed back to the center-southeast of Kythoria. With nowhere left to retreat, the survivors resolved to make their final stand. Rather than perish, they built.

## The Three Capitals

Three cities were founded, each serving a unique strategic purpose:

- **Skywatch (The Lookout)**: The highest-elevated city, serving as the primary scouting and observation post
- **Emberforge (The Forge)**: Built beneath a volcanic ash wasteland, harnessing geothermal heat for industry
- **Weaveheart (The Nexus)**: Built at a convergence of ley lines, the arcane and research heart

## The Magical Barrier

A stable, reliable magical barrier was developed in Weaveheart, powered by the unique ley line convergence. First developed to protect that city alone, it was later expanded to create a perimeter encompassing all three capitals. The barrier has held for two centuries.

## Outcome

The founding of the Last Stand marked the end of **The Abominable End** and the beginning of **The Rise of the Mortals** era. From this safe haven, the mortal races formed the **First Alliance**  -  the army of the Last Stand  -  and began the reconquering of their lost territories.

## Aftermath

The three capitals have grown from desperate refuges into thriving centers of civilization. The magical barrier remains in place, constantly maintained by Weaveheart's mages. The south and east have been fully reclaimed, and the reconquering continues to push westward.
